identity.authorization: The public player has no private privileges and exposes only human-reviewed releases. The Studio teacher training gate is enforced at the Studio origin and is not silently inherited by this public application.
identity.session: No student or teacher login, credentials, tokens or local user session are maintained by the public player. Browser memory state is limited to local timer, navigation and the displayed public lesson.

requestApiAi.controls: No model calls, no provider API, no AI Core invocation, no dynamic translation endpoint and no autonomous actions. Offline contextual glosses are part of approved lesson JSON.

egress.networkPolicy: Fetches are limited to a canonical same-origin JSON catalog and hash-pinned lesson bytes; redirected, opaque and mismatched content responses fail closed. No external QR, analytics, translation or CDN calls.

files.imports: No student upload or source import is supported in the public player. Private editorial materials never enter public source or preview artifacts.
files.quarantine: Content candidates are inspected in the private repository, individually reviewed and SHA-256 allowlisted before a separately authorized clean distribution.

dataLifecycle.classification: Public lesson material only, no private teacher or student records. Review metadata is private and excluded from distributed artifacts.
dataLifecycle.storage: Local timer is transient RAM. No localStorage, sessionStorage or indexedDB is required. Future service worker may store only explicitly enumerated public shell files under a distinct Conversation Lab cache prefix; lesson JSON and catalog must remain network-only.
dataLifecycle.retention: Public copies can be independently archived by recipients. Withdrawn material cannot be reliably remotely erased after download; no expiry is promised.

release.promotion: Public build is NO_GO until formal E7 content review and E8 exact-hash release approval, verified origin/HTTPS and private-to-public clean export.
release.rollback: Halt publication, block affected catalog descriptor in a newly approved release and document that offline copies and old QR links may remain obtainable.

inventory.source: Daniel22-dev/conversation-lab-source, private only. Local QR generator is vendored and its attribution is retained.
inventory.changeRule: Any appId, origin, Service Worker scope, publish policy, hosting or provider API change requires a new security and editorial review.

securityHealth.localCi: E2-E6 local and read-only GitHub Actions tests are a development quality signal, not live GARP certification.
securityHealth.live: NOT_TESTED: no approved public origin, server, live headers or physical device evidence for Conversation Lab.
securityHealth.failureMode: Reject invalid origin, framed embedded playback, malformed routes, unsafe network payloads, stale SHA-256 and unapproved catalog items.

incident.response: Stop promotion, assess source/public history and caches, withdraw affected approved descriptors in a separately authorized release, and notify project owner; change signing material if compromised.
incident.contacts: School-appointed owner and future release maintainer, as defined during E8/E9 governance.

recovery.rollback: Use a last-known-good approved public release after exact-hash verification and re-run negative tests. No automatic rollback, no private key in browser or CI, no deletion guarantee for previously downloaded copies.
recovery.backup: All E6 development source and QA evidence remain in the private version-controlled repository.
